column1: # Sublineages of M. tuberculosis lineage 1, from Netikul T et al. Whole-genome single nucleotide variant phylogenetic
# analysis of Mycobacterium tuberculosis Lineage 1 in endemic regions of Asia and Africa. Sci Rep 12:1565 (2022).
# https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-022-05524-0. Supplementary Table S6: the 1,835 sublineage-specific SNPs (barcode:
# the 125 SNPs proposed as barcode). Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. Positions and alleles on the H37Rv
# reference genome NC_000962.3 (plus strand; the alleles of the paper are on the gene strand, complemented here for
# the genes on the minus strand). group: the sublineage defined by the derived (non-H37Rv) allele.
